profile_text.body:
The website at alantra.com describes Alantra, an international financial services firm with over 500 professionals across EMEA, the Americas, and Asia. It says the firm provides investment banking and alternative asset management services to corporations, family-owned companies, and institutional investors. The site describes a listed partnership model in which teams operate within corporate governance structures but are personally invested in the firm.

The company is recorded as ALLIENT INC, a public company headquartered in Williamsville, NY, with ticker ALNT and SEC CIK 0000046129. The data shows 458 law exposure entries in New York. No products or MCP servers are listed.
